note: Deterministic correctness and subjective product quality are separate layers. An automated grader never stands in for layer 4.

layers.name: Deterministic contract checks
layers.what_exists: Application Pack schema validation, citation resolution, forbidden export phrases, resume-bullet count, answer claim-safety gate, and expected evidence statuses.
layers.metric: severe check pass/fail per case per system; citation counts

layers.name: Component quality
layers.what_exists: Day 2 intake extraction and routing cases, Day 3 context selection comparison, Context Registry reuse and invalidation, selective routing, and Skill behavior cases.
layers.unmeasured: component behavior against a live host, live model, or real project corpus

layers.name: End-to-end task success
layers.what_exists: Three recorded strong-prompt versus Project2Job Application Pack pairs on the S01/S02/S05 boundary cases, plus the Agent update-versus-fresh-replay mechanics comparison.
layers.metric: severe-gate pass rate and citation resolution rate over 3 cases per system
layers.unmeasured: task success on unseen projects; n=3 supports direction, not a rate

layers.name: Human product judgement
layers.what_exists: A blind packet, a 0-3 rubric, blank two-reviewer forms, a disagreement form, and a written protocol. One product-owner target-user dogfood session is recorded separately.
layers.metric: none recorded; every score field is null
layers.unmeasured: reviewer scores, preference, disagreement, and every subjective rubric dimension

layers.name: Real user and outcome evidence
layers.what_exists: A blank bounded target-user pilot record.
layers.unmeasured: adoption, external use, application results, and hiring outcomes
